# Delib · 審議拼圖

Delib helps people run online, in-person, and hybrid deliberation across repeated
rounds: choose tools, preserve source context, respond to participants, and choose
a justified next step. The public homepage supports Traditional Chinese and English.

## Start here

- Human workflow, 3D process, synthetic demo, and generated agent brief: https://delib.mashbean.net/
- Bilingual workflow, grouped tools and methodology sources: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/workflow-guide.json
- Canonical agent skill: https://delib.mashbean.net/.well-known/delib/SKILL.md
- OpenClaw-compatible skill alias (same content): https://delib.mashbean.net/.well-known/openclaw/SKILL.md
- Current documented integration operations: https://delib.mashbean.net/api/integrations
- Native station paths and service origins: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/tool-stations.json
- Browser-only CSV validation and conversion: https://delib.mashbean.net/handoff
- Source: https://github.com/mashbean/delib

## Native stations

- Pocket Form — recruitment, experiences, and surveys: https://delib.mashbean.net/form
- Pocket Harmonica — guided reflection: https://delib.mashbean.net/harmonica
- Pocket Polis — agreement, disagreement, and pass: https://delib.mashbean.net/polis
- Call-in — presentation-linked participation: https://delib.mashbean.net/call-in
- Pocket TTTC — topics, claims, and source quotes: https://delib.mashbean.net/tttc
- Pocket Reply — responses and follow-up: https://delib.mashbean.net/reply
- Power Ranker — pairwise priorities: https://delib.mashbean.net/rank
- Pocket Values — values and trade-offs: https://delib.mashbean.net/values
- Pocket Budget — proposals under a budget: https://delib.mashbean.net/budget
- Pocket Check — claims and shared understanding: https://delib.mashbean.net/checks
- Pocket Proposals — proposals and revisions: https://delib.mashbean.net/proposals
- Pocket Argument — reasons and objections: https://delib.mashbean.net/argument
- Pocket Maple — policy materials and participation: https://delib.mashbean.net/maple

Prefer native stations when they meet the need. Their series paths lead to existing
services, not duplicate participant databases. Original services remain advanced
alternatives; their features, authorization, hosting, and credentials differ.

## Contracts and evidence

- Common source and privacy envelope: https://delib.mashbean.net/schemas/delib-data/v1.json
- Iterative rounds, presence, source lineage, and next steps: https://delib.mashbean.net/schemas/delib-rounds/v1.json
- Synthetic school-street demo fixture: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/flow-demo.json
- Eight-stage process reference: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/deliberation-process.json
- Tool catalog and original projects: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/tools.json
- Integration audit with dates and service boundaries: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/integrations.json
- Source, license, and hosting audit: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/hosting.json
- Deployment recipes: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/deployments.json
- Deployment and interoperability comparison: https://delib.mashbean.net/data/tool-comparison.json
- Deployment center: https://delib.mashbean.net/deploy
- Tool and interoperability feedback: https://delib.mashbean.net/feedback

A registry entry is documentation, not proof of current service health or a tested
handoff. Read dates and verify the selected operation. Delib schemas are versioned
project contracts; flat-file support does not imply universal interoperability.

The data workbench processes its supported files in browser memory. Downloaded
files may still contain participant data, and a downstream tool has its own storage
and processing boundary. Real participant-linked round bundles are private; use a
separate, minimized, human-reviewed receipt for publication. Management links and
credentials never belong in public outputs.

The demo is entirely synthetic. Its people, votes, observations, and decisions do
not represent real residents or show that a live event was created. Keep synthetic
and real records separate and preserve source references and conversion losses.

## Agent boundary

Delib offers a downloadable skill and generated brief for the organizer's own AI
agent. The homepage does not collect AI API keys. The former /api/agent endpoint
is retired and returns HTTP 410. Individual tools may still use AI and have their
own accounts, limits, and policies.

Act as a bounded local steward. Reuse the organizer's existing authorization;
prepare specific external actions for review when authorization is still missing.
Never invent participation or consensus, vote for people, or promote an AI summary
to a formal decision. Preserve disagreement, source context, and correction paths.
Report observed creation, data transfer, publication, and delivery separately.
End each round with an accountable response and an explicit next action or closure.
